Container.Name: snappy-finance
Container.Overview: Self-hosted personal finance dashboard. Configure the PostgreSQL connection and app secrets below. The database is external and is not included in this container.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web UI port published on the Unraid server.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Host
Config.Description: PostgreSQL container DNS name on a shared Docker network, or the Unraid LAN IP when PostgreSQL publishes its port.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL User
Config.Description: PostgreSQL role with access to the configured database.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL SSL mode
Config.Description: Use require if your PostgreSQL server requires TLS.

Config.Name: Administrator Username
Config.Description: Username for the first administrator profile created in an empty database.

Config.Name: Administrator Password
Config.Description: Password for first-run administrator setup (12-72 characters). Existing databases keep their current profiles and do not reset passwords.

Config.Name: Legacy App Password
Config.Description: Compatibility fallback for older deployments. Prefer Administrator Password.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Random secret of at least 32 characters. Keep unchanged across upgrades.

Config.Name: Access Token Encryption Key
Config.Description: Base64-encoded random 32-byte key. Back it up and keep unchanged; losing it prevents decrypting stored Plaid tokens.

Config.Name: Plaid Environment
Config.Description: Plaid environment: sandbox, development, or production.

Config.Name: Plaid Client ID
Config.Description: Plaid client ID. Leave blank to disable bank linking.

Config.Name: Plaid Secret
Config.Description: Plaid secret for the selected environment.

Config.Name: Sync Interval
Config.Description: How often to check linked Plaid Items for transaction updates.

Config.Name: Seed demo data
Config.Description: Set true only for a test database to add fictional accounts and transactions.
